additional_info.subject: Cases handed over from NOC to Expert (L3)
additional_info.body:
Suspected Root Cause:
Potential bug or firmware issue.
Problem Description:
The charger displayed unavailability (out of order) during the charging session due to a COAP polling error.
Action Performed (L2):
Analyzed the logs for identifying potential causes.
Charger SW Version:
4.0.11
Reason for Handover (L3):
Further in-depth analysis required to identify root cause and resolution.
Log Analysis with Timestamp:
On
2024-12-14 at 11:08:13 am
, the charger failed to send the
startTransaction
message to the backend, resulting in an
Unregistered Session
.
Additionally, the SECC unavailability lasted for more than
15 minutes
, contributing to the session issue.
Action Required:
Detailed analysis of the firmware and backend communication.
Check SECC module logs and investigate any hardware/software inconsistencies.
Attachments:
Refer to the attached logs for detailed insights.
